Package org.aristonis.diwan.database

Class TransactionOptions

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.TransactionOptions
public final class TransactionOptions extends Object
Settings of one outermost transaction: how long it waits for a lock and how many times it runs.

An instance is immutable. none() and the static factories start a chain, and each instance method returns a new copy with one setting changed, so TransactionOptions.lockWait(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).withAttempts(3) combines both.

A lock wait longer than zero is rounded up to whole milliseconds, so a positive duration never becomes "no wait".

    • none

      public static TransactionOptions none()
      Returns the options that change nothing: the database default lock wait and a single attempt.
      Returns:
      the shared default options, never null

    • lockWait

      public static TransactionOptions lockWait(Duration wait)
      Returns options with a lock wait and a single attempt.
      Parameters:
      wait - the longest the transaction waits for a lock, more than zero and at most Integer.MAX_VALUE milliseconds; a sub-millisecond value rounds up to 1 ms
      Returns:
      the new options, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if wait is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if wait is zero, negative or longer than Integer.MAX_VALUE milliseconds

    • attempts

      public static TransactionOptions attempts(int attempts)

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the new options, never null
      Throws:
